documents.name: Distribution Agreement - Brenner Medical.txt
documents.text:
DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between Calloway Instruments Ltd (the "Supplier") and Brenner Medical GmbH (the "Distributor").

1. Term
1.1 This Agreement continues for five (5) years from 12 January 2026.

2. Change of control
2.1 If either party undergoes a change of control, the other party may terminate this Agreement on thirty (30) days' notice.

3. Assignment
3.1 Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other.

4. Targets
4.1 The Supplier may terminate this Agreement if the Distributor fails to meet the Minimum Purchase Target.

5. Liability
5.1 Each party's liability under this Agreement shall not exceed EUR 1,000,000 (fictional).

6. Law
6.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of Germany.

LEASE (fictional)

This Lease is made between Harbour Estates Limited (the "Landlord") and Brenner Medical GmbH (the "Tenant").

1. Term
1.1 "Term Commencement Date" means 1 April 2026.

2. Break
2.1 The Tenant may terminate this Lease on the fifth anniversary of the Term Commencement Date by giving not less than six (6) months' notice.

3. Law
3.1 This Lease is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
